entries.englishDefinition: The address specified as the destination for delivered goods or parcels.
entries.requiredObject: Physical delivery destination; this is not an email address or a computer address.
contrasts: A billing address identifies the billing role; it need not be the delivery destination.
Shipping address is a separate legitimate lexical expression, not an inflection to rewrite into this head.
entries.formNotes: Only the ordinary plural delivery addresses is proposed.

entries.englishDefinition: To put washed clothing or linen outside on a line or similar support to dry.
entries.requiredObject: The complete household expression includes the washing. Washing is an uncountable collective noun here.
contrasts: Hang out without this object can concern spending time somewhere or socialising; that meaning is not admitted here.
This draft specifies outdoor drying. It does not declare every indoor hanging/drying action equivalent.
entries.formNotes: Hang uses hung, not hanged, in this sense. Exactly the listed complete word-order variants are proposed; no productive object substitution rule.

entries.englishDefinition: To carry household rubbish outside to a bin or collection place.
entries.regionalLabel: rubbish is the usual British term
entries.requiredObject: The rubbish is the household-waste object. The listed noun-object orders are both possible.
contrasts: Take out the trash and take out the garbage are common North American expressions, but are not silently admitted as inflections of this different lexical head.
Dump can have broader disposal, sales and computing senses; those are not unconditional equivalents.
entries.formNotes: Take has took/taken. Only the listed complete forms and noun-object orders are proposed; pronoun placement is not a new runtime rewrite rule.

entries.englishDefinition: To measure a person's body temperature.
entries.requiredObject: Someone's/somebody's identifies the person whose body temperature is measured; that person may be the measurer or another person. Concrete possessives are admitted only as the listed complete surfaces.
contrasts: Measuring temperature does not itself mean that the person has a fever.
A room or machine temperature is outside this body-temperature expression.
entries.formNotes: Take has takes/took/taken/taking. The listed one's surfaces are retained for self-context use, such as a person measuring their own temperature; this does not assert that one's is globally ungrammatical in other constructions. No arbitrary pronoun or possessive substitution rule is proposed.
entries.selfContextExampleNote: A generic instruction about measuring one's own temperature can use take one's temperature. The retained nurse took my temperature example instead measures another person's body temperature, so the broad canonical head is take someone's temperature. This note is explanatory only; no extra learning example is admitted.

entries.englishDefinition: A response of the body triggered by an allergen.
entries.requiredObject: Generic reaction noun phrase; no specific allergen, symptom, severity or treatment is inferred.
contrasts: Effects can vary from mild to serious; this general noun phrase does not itself specify their severity.
Anaphylaxis is a specific severe reaction, not an unconditional synonym of every allergic reaction.
Anaphylactic and anaphylactoid are adjectives/specialised terms and cannot stand in for this generic noun phrase.
Adverse reaction and poisoning are not automatically allergy.
entries.formNotes: Only the ordinary plural allergic reactions is proposed.

entries.englishDefinition: A prescription used to obtain an established medicine again under an ongoing prescribing arrangement.
entries.requiredObject: This is a British countable prescription noun for continuing medicine use. The Chinese alias 续方 has this noun sense here, not every act of renewing, issuing or dispensing medicine.
contrasts: Repeat prescribing and repeat dispensing can use different arrangements; the expression does not require a newly issued prescription for every supply.
A pharmacy refill or any medicine renewal is not automatically the same prescription concept.
The expression does not promise unlimited supplies, automatic approval, availability, dosage or exemption from review or consultation.
Repeated or duplicate prescribing in error is not this intended continuing-use sense.
entries.formNotes: Only the ordinary plural repeat prescriptions is proposed. The example is an enquiry about approval, not an entitlement.

entries.englishDefinition: A service or arrangement for temporarily keeping travellers' bags until they collect them.
entries.requiredObject: Temporary keeping of travel bags; a locker or staffed service may be involved.
contrasts: Checked baggage/airline baggage check-in is a different service.
Baggage reclaim is collecting arriving baggage, not arranging temporary storage.
The storage service or arrangement is not unconditionally the office, counter or room where it is provided.
No price, security, opening-hours or availability guarantee follows from this noun phrase.
entries.formNotes: No ordinary plural luggage storages is admitted.

entries.englishDefinition: A work schedule showing which shifts each member of staff is assigned.
entries.regionalLabel: especially British English; compare American roster
entries.requiredObject: Employee shift/time allocation, not a change in position, a general list of names or a school timetable.
contrasts: Rota can be broader and include other duties; this compound specifies work shifts.
No equivalence with every sense of shift, roster or timetable is proposed.
entries.formNotes: Only the ordinary plural shift rotas is proposed.

entries.englishDefinition: Information supplied to a prospective employer about an applicant's work history, performance or suitability for a role.
entries.regionalLabel: general; primary workplace evidence is British
entries.requiredObject: This draft covers reference information supplied for recruitment, including factual work or character/suitability information.
contrasts: A reference can be factual/basic or detailed; it is not necessarily a favourable recommendation.
It can be written or verbal; 雇主推荐信 is not admitted as an unconditional letter-only equivalence.
Referee names/contact people and a general employment certificate are separate contexts, not newly admitted meanings here.
The noun does not imply that a reference must legally be supplied or that a job offer follows.
entries.formNotes: Only the ordinary plural employment references is proposed.
